# RC35 — Local workspace outline

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/projects/w.scrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc g O` / `:outline` / `:workspace-outline` / `:project-outline` / `:local-symbols`.
- Opens a searchable `WORKSPACE OUTLINE` picker built from the immutable project text-index snapshot.
- Uses local lexical outline extraction for recognized source/Markdown files; no LSP is required.
- Bounds the scan to the first 2,000 indexed files, 1 MiB per file, and 4,096 retained symbols.
- Shows `path:line` plus declaration/heading labels, filters locally, opens the selected file, moves the cursor, and records jump history.
- Brackets the scan with workspace-root identity validation so stale root swaps refuse before publishing path-associated results.
